title: Geologic map of California, Mariposa sheet

bi.name: Mesozoic basic intrusive rocks
bi.description: Quartz diorite, diorite, gabbro and related basic intrusive rocks grouped at regional scale. This small mapped body lies in the surrounding context area, outside the atlas terrain.

gr.name: Mesozoic granitic rocks
gr.description: Regional grouping of granitic plutons, including granite, quartz monzonite and granodiorite. The source combines many named and unnamed units; it does not distinguish the local pluton within these watersheds.

processing: Official CGS geodatabase vectors transformed from NAD83 / California Albers (EPSG:3310) to UTM11 for clipping, then WGS84. A 2 km context margin surrounds the existing terrain. No simplification, inferred contacts, terrain snapping, or field-scale subdivision. Colors are atlas display colors.
limitations: Regional interpretation at 1:250,000. Both watersheds and the complete terrain footprint lie in the generalized gr unit. Contacts are not surveyed well-scale boundaries. This layer does not resolve local plutons, weathering depth, fractures, groundwater, rock thickness or active fault status.
notes: The small bi body and its contact are outside the atlas terrain, retained for surrounding regional context.
The full CGS geodatabase unit table was used; truncated shapefile descriptions were not used.
The more detailed USGS Shaver Lake quadrangle map (1976, 1:62,500) covers this area, but its scanned-map reference is not converted into invented vector contacts.

references.title: Lockwood and Bateman (1976), Shaver Lake quadrangle, USGS GQ-1271
references.note: Detailed map reference; not the source of this vector layer.

references.title: USGS National Geologic Map Database: Shaver Lake map
